correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the standardized reading projects the fourth power onto the constant, second and fourth Hermite terms. Their squared norms give the two explained-variance components, and integrating the matching Hermite covariance over the time triangle gives total variance 38/5. I independently reproduced the stationary polynomial and its transformed signs: degrees 0 through 6 are nonnegative with degree 3 positive even at zero noise; degree 7 is strictly negative. Descartes plus the two endpoint signs proves one simple interior turning point and a global maximum of explained variance, with the zero-time gain defined as zero also at zero noise. The derivative of F/(x+eta) has the stated unique quadratic-energy maximizer, and both positive quotient derivatives force the quartic gain still to be increasing there. Scaling the derivative by eta^3 at x=1-c/eta gives 72c-9 at inverse noise zero; the simple root and uniqueness give the 1/(8 eta) correction. The zero-noise quartic and endpoint risk agree with the exact identities.
residual_risks: One deterministic noisy Brownian reading and unconditional Bayes MSE only; the symbolic replay checks algebra, while the sign and implicit-function arguments prove the continuum statements.
